scripts.dev: command -v astro >/dev/null 2>&1 && astro dev || node scripts/static-build.mjs --serve
scripts.build:site: command -v astro >/dev/null 2>&1 && astro build || node scripts/static-build.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate:stats && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run build:site
scripts.preview: command -v astro >/dev/null 2>&1 && astro preview || node scripts/static-build.mjs --serve
scripts.validate: command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1 && tsx scripts/validate-data.ts || node --loader ./scripts/ts-loader.mjs scripts/validate-data.ts
scripts.generate:stats: command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1 && tsx scripts/generate-stats.ts || node --loader ./scripts/ts-loader.mjs scripts/generate-stats.ts
scripts.generate:sitemap: command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1 && tsx scripts/generate-sitemap.ts || node --loader ./scripts/ts-loader.mjs scripts/generate-sitemap.ts
scripts.check: npm run generate:stats && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run validate && npm run validate:candidates && npm run validate:latest-batch && npm run validate:tokenized && npm run monitor:tokenized && npm run build:site
